reuse.why: Routes every server and client copy through the existing shared getScheduledAmount, reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the approximate tolerance, and builds the API field from the same helper on top of scheduleModel.toExternal.

duplication.why: Removes the inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) and adds no new copy of the rule or of the tolerance arithmetic.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the API only decorates its list result, and the type is declared next to APIScheduleEntity in api-models.ts.

scope.why: Changes stay on the expected-amount rule and its consumers, though the client display/filter sites now also pass the operator and show the planning amount, which goes a little beyond what the steps ask.

maintainability.why: One small, well-tested definition, but `amountOp` is inserted positionally before `inverse` and typed as a loose string, and forecast's normalizeSchedule now stores the planned value under the `_amount` name.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts gains the `amountOp` parameter (placed before `inverse`) and an `isapprox` branch; all consumers call it, and useScheduleEdit.ts keeps the one-argument form
